rows.name: value
rows.description: Controlled time string (format follows is24Hour / delimiter), e.g. "14:30" or "2:30 PM".

rows.name: onChange
rows.description: Fired with the new time string on every edit.

rows.name: is24Hour
rows.description: Use 24-hour time. Default is 12-hour with AM/PM.

rows.name: stepMinutes
rows.description: Minutes between suggested times in the popover (e.g. 15, 30).

rows.name: minTime
rows.description: Earliest selectable time (same string format as value).

rows.name: delimiter
rows.description: Separator between hours and minutes. Default ":".

rows.name: id
rows.description: Field id — pairs with a FormGroup fieldId.
